title: To appropriate the sum of $4,200,000 from the General Fund of the Federated States of Micronesia for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026, for the purpose of funding public projects and social programs for the people of Yap, Kosrae, Pohnpei, and Chuuk states, and for other purposes.
text:
TWENTY-FOURTH CONGRESS OF THE FEDERATED STATES OF MICRONESIA
THIRD REGULAR SESSION, 2026 CONGRESSIONAL BILL NO. 24-102, C.D.1
P.C. NO. 24-226 PUBLIC LAW NO. 24-56
AN ACT
To appropriate the sum of $4,200,000 from the General Fund of the
Federated States of Micronesia for the fiscal year ending September
30, 2026, for the purpose of funding public projects and social
programs for the people of Yap, Kosrae, Pohnpei, and Chuuk states,
and for other purposes.
BE IT ENACTED BY THE CONGRESS OF THE FEDERATED STATES OF MICRONESIA:
1 Section 1. The sum of $4,200,000, or so much thereof as may
2 be necessary, is hereby appropriated from the General Fund of the
3 Federated States of Micronesia for the fiscal year ending
4 September 30, 2026, for the purpose of funding public projects and
5 social programs for the people of Yap, Kosrae, Pohnpei, and Chuuk
6 states. The funds appropriated under this section shall be
7 apportioned as follows:

2 Section 6. Allotment and management of funds and lapse date.
3 All funds appropriated by this act shall be allotted, managed,
4 administered and accounted for in accordance with applicable laws,
5 including, but not limited to, the Financial Management Act of
6 1979. The allottee shall be responsible for ensuring that these
7 funds, or so much thereof as may be necessary, are used solely for
8 the purpose specified in this act, and that no obligations are
9 incurred in excess of the sum appropriated. The allottee of the
10 funds appropriated under section 2 of this act shall be the

15 the Mayor of Lelu Town Government or his designee. The allottee
